scope: controlled optimizer research; not full life-model admission
question: Does the same material state produce useful learning/retention at an acceptable whole-model cost on real byte traffic?

lean_scope.applicability: same c2 state, energy, readout, stock guard, independent row/column matching; separate tensor compartments
lean_scope.required_runtime_checks: current CUDA reference tests; all finite gradients and exact readout; full model/optimizer/RNG continuation and causal logits
lean_scope.error_scope: finite coin error is budgeted; observed exponential checks are numerical evidence, not a universal IEEE bound
lean_scope.conditional_boundary: random-site holding/wear/service time constants are not sweep-clock guarantees; no arbitrary loss is assumed to satisfy descent/retention premises
lean_scope.experimental_scope: after interface preflight, execute registered finite optimizer comparison; healthy lifetime behavior remains unadmitted

data.tokenizer: UTF8 byte offset4 plus four specials; vocabulary260
data.domain_rule: length>=512; fixed character-density bottom/top training thirds; heldout uses training thresholds
data.test_split: hash checked only; never scored or used to set thresholds

model.kind: ordinary causal transformer optimizer testbed; not a derived CGB architecture
model.state: context128; no persistent neural state; optimizer state continues through every phase

experiment.initialization: same scratch Gaussian initialization projected to the material seven-level alphabet in all arms

material.H: existing c2,a16,J12,mu2,scaled quadratic pools; independent parameter compartments
material.external_wear: none injected; old wear/time certificates not inherited

measurements.primary: first-pass prequential bits/actual UTF8 target byte, scored before each update
secondary: independent validation byte NLL per domain
measurements.units: actual bytes are targets4..259; boundary targets1/2 reported separately; no unicode-character BPB claim
measurements.replay: none: second A continues its fresh cursor; no repeated train targets within an arm
measurements.bridges: last target before each domain switch is the actual next domain's first input byte and is logged explicitly
measurements.checkpoint: model, optimizer physical state/RNG, pending gradients, all Torch RNGs, updates, stream cursors and metric accumulators
measurements.convergence: 5000 is a fixed budget, not assumed convergence; report last five validation values and slope; no early success stopping
measurements.interpretation: Adam can leave the seven-level grid: comparison is of optimizer+representation packages, not isolated update quality

decision_rules.positive: material improves independent future byte loss and beats no-force control; compare plasticity/return-A and resource costs to Adam
decision_rules.negative: failure to improve over no-force or persistent training failure rejects this instantiated H/force/representation package
decision_rules.ambiguous: budget-limited/nonconverged or one-seed results cannot settle general optimizer superiority
do_not_claim: healthy lifetime lock from one language curve
infinite attribution from this context128 model
